verdict.rationale: dltHub is a platform with managed infrastructure and a CLI/Web UI, so publishing a machine-readable spec of its own API is a fair question. However, probes of all standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404, and no docs mention a downloadable spec for dlt or dltHub's own API. The dlt-init-openapi tool consumes third-party OpenAPI specs to generate pipelines; it does not publish a spec for dlt itself, so it doesn't count here.
